collect_hint: Press Start to collect nicknames from matches
invite_hint: Launches the game, opens the clan and invites players
hint_bottom: — stop · closing the window sends it to the tray
setup_sources: Enter the nicknames to collect from
help_api: A free key from the PUBG developers. Click “Get a key”, sign in at developer.pubg.com, create an app (Get Your API Key) and paste the long key here — it starts with eyJ. Do not share it with anyone.
help_sources: PUBG nicknames whose recent matches are used to collect opponents and teammates. One per line, exactly as in the game. Your own nickname and friends who play a lot work best: the more they play, the more new nicknames you get.
help_interval: How often to look for new matches of the players in the list while collection is running. 15–30 minutes is usually enough.
help_stale: If a player has not been seen in matches for this many days, the nickname is removed — they most likely stopped playing.
help_recheck: After how many days to check again whether a player who has not been invited yet joined a clan.
opt_precheck: Check the clan right before inviting
data_folder_tt: Folder with the database and the log
already_running: The program is already running — its icon is in the tray next to the clock.
d_precheck: Checking that the players are still without a clan
l_precheck_failed: The pre-invite check failed ({err}) — inviting without it
l_no_valid: No valid nicknames — start collecting and wait
d_wait_game: Waiting for the game to start
d_wait_lobby: Waiting for the lobby and opening the clan page
l_focus_wait: The game window is not active — waiting, switch to the game
l_restart_lobby: The lobby did not load completely — restarting the lobby
l_no_tab: Invites tab not found — closing the clan page
l_dialog_enter: A window covers the lobby — pressing Enter (the main button, usually “Reconnect”)
l_dialog_esc: The lobby is still covered — pressing Esc
e_no_invite_page: could not open the clan invite page
l_page_lost: The invite page disappeared — opening it again
e_no_ocr: Windows has no text recognition (OCR) language installed
e_bad_key: the API key is invalid or expired
e_net: no connection to the PUBG API ({err})
e_no_sources: no nicknames to collect from in the settings
l_source_missing: Collection: player {nick} not found in PUBG — check the nickname in the settings
l_collect_summary: Collection: matches {m}, checked {c}, without a clan {v}
kick_hint: Opens Clan member activity and kicks members that match the criteria
help_kick_xp: Kick if the weekly clan XP in the activity table is below this number. 0 turns it off.
help_kick_days: Kick if the player has not logged in for this many days. Taken from the online status column of the activity table ("Был(а) в сети 3 дн. назад"); only the Russian game client is supported so far. "Не в сети" (Offline) counts as long ago too. 0 turns it off.
help_kick_grace: How many days to leave new members alone: those the app first saw in the clan or invited recently. On the first check every current member counts as an old one.
help_kick_dry: The app opens the game, reads the table and only writes to the log whom it would kick. Turn it off once the list looks right.
help_kick_excl: Nicknames to leave alone even if they match the criteria. One per line. Put your officers here: the app does not read roles (the game does not let anyone kick the leader anyway).
l_kick_candidates: Cleanup: {n} match the criteria (at most {limit} per run):
l_kick_dry: Dry run, nobody is kicked. Turn it off in Settings once the list looks right.
e_no_clan_page: could not open the clan members page
e_no_activity: could not find the Clan member activity table
r_kick_not_found: not found in the members list
r_kick_no_menu: the member menu did not open
r_kick_not_confirmed: kick not confirmed, still in the list
l_no_members_tab: Members tab not found, closing the clan page
r_kick_no_dialog: no confirmation dialog (the game did not allow the kick, e.g. the player is in a match)
r_kick_wrong_dialog: the confirmation names another player, cancelled
kick_need_criteria: Set the criteria in Settings: minimum clan XP, days without matches or Offline
help_kick_offline: The game shows Offline instead of "Last online … ago" when a player has not logged in for a long time. It is a criterion of its own and also counts for "No matches". The status text is not read: Offline is recognized because it is about half as long as the others.
members_tt: Clan member statistics from every check
m_summary: In the clan: {n} · last check: {when} · checks: {scans}
m_never: No checks yet: run a cleanup (a dry run is fine) and the app will read the activity table.
m_show_gone: Show members who left or were kicked
r_kick_rehearsed: rehearsal: reached the confirmation, pressed Cancel
d_kicking_all: Kicking up to {n}, going down the members list
k_skip_twins: Cleanup: nicknames differ only in look-alike letters, kept ({n}): {names}
help_learn: Needed when the game is not in Russian. Russian is built in and works right away.
learn_about: The not-logged-in criterion reads the online status column ("Last online 3 d ago"). Russian is built in. For another game language the app learns by itself: after every check it remembers the members' statuses and compares them with earlier checks. If a player stayed offline, the number in the status grew by the time that passed: by 1 an hour for an hours word, by 1 a day for a days word. That tells what the word after the number means, no dictionary needed. Phrases without a number ("a day ago") are learned from the checks next to them. It takes 2–3 checks a few hours apart (a dry run is fine). Until a word is learned the criterion does not fire for those players; XP and Offline work as usual.
learn_none: Nothing learned yet; not needed for the Russian client.
learn_reset_tt: Forget the learned words and learn again (e.g. after changing the game language)
learn_reset_confirm: Forget the learned status words and learn again?
l_kick_status_unknown: Cleanup: {n} members have a status in an unknown language; not-logged-in will work for them once the words are learned (2–3 checks a few hours apart)
